how_it_works.title: How it
how_it_works.subtitle: From creating the event to welcoming your guests.

1.title: Create your event
1.desc: Title, date, time, venue, dress code and a note for your guests: this information fills in the invitation on its own.

2.title: Pick and customise a template
2.desc: Browse the gallery by type of event, then change the text, photos, colours, opening screen and music. The preview follows every change.

3.title: Add your guests and send
3.desc: Enter them one by one or import a CSV file. Each one receives their personal link by email, or on WhatsApp with a ready-to-send message.

4.title: Follow replies, welcome your guests
4.desc: You see who opened their invitation and who is coming. Each guest who confirms gets their ticket, which you scan at the door on the day.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: What to know before creating your invitation.

items.q: Do my guests need an account?
items.a: No. Each guest opens their invitation with their personal link and replies right inside it.

items.q: What can I change in a template?
items.a: The text, photos, links, colours, the opening screen (style, title, monogram) and the music. The layout stays the template's.

items.q: How does sending on WhatsApp work?
items.a: Invyra opens WhatsApp with a ready-to-send message containing the guest's personal link: you only have to send it. Add your number in your settings, and the guest's number in your list.
For each guest: sending by email or WhatsApp, the opening of the invitation and their reply (attending, not attending or maybe). Each event's totals are in your analytics.

items.q: Can a guest change their reply?
items.a: Yes. By opening their link again, they can reply again: the new reply replaces the previous one.

items.q: How does check-in work on the day?
items.a: Each guest who confirms receives a ticket with a QR code. On the day, the person at the door opens the check-in link on their phone: they scan tickets or look up a guest by name, without creating an account.

items.q: Can my guests share their photos?
items.a: Yes. From their invitation, each guest can reach the guestbook and add their photos and videos, which the other guests can see. You can hide an item or close sharing at any time.

items.q: How many guests on the free plan?
items.a: Up to 15 guests for one event. Beyond that, the Premium event costs $1 per guest, with no limit on numbers.

items.q: Can I prepare the event with others?
items.a: Yes. Add someone who has an Invyra account, as an editor (they edit and send) or as a viewer (they follow the replies).
Each link is unique and hard to guess, and invitation pages are not listed by search engines.
